chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, was asked:
about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic,
"Who is it that will lend to Allah a goodly loan?"
He said: "It was revealed concerning maintaining connection with the Imam, peace be upon him."

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam; the divinely designated leader
key_terms.صِلَةِ: maintaining connection, support, or dutiful relation
key_terms.قَرْضًا حَسَنًا: a goodly loan; a sincere and worthy offering for Allah's cause

ai.seo_question: What does "Who is it that will lend to Allah a goodly loan" mean according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام explains this Qur'anic phrase as referring to supporting and maintaining connection with the Imam عليه السلام. The narration presents the 'goodly loan' as an act tied to the rights and support of the Imam within the Shia understanding of religious authority.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1763 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked
about the saying of Allah (swt), the Almighty:
"Who is it that will lend to Allah (swt) a goodly loan?"
Imam (as) said: "It was revealed concerning the support of the Imam (as)."
